content: {"like":["Tyrone Power brings his likable charm and spirit to screen","Victoria Shaw is quite lovely and expressive"],"dislike":["Power and Kim Novak play uninteresting and under-developed characters","Montage of Central Park is perfect, schmaltzy, and dull","Almost every reference to Eddy Duchy's Jewish identity is taken out","There's not a single reference to anti-semitism in this film","The Eddie Duchin Story opts to milk the tragedies of Eddy Duchin for all its worth","Chopin would be rolling around in his grave if he heard this rendition of his Nocturne in E-flat Major","He shows Irish-American identity and experience whereas this film skips over ethnicity"]}
